label: OF3 code + stock OpenFold3 0.5.0 as the kit defines it, no templates, openbind weights
tag: OF3 code / kit off / openbind weights
notes: mode off: upstream's own entry point on the kit's STOCK configuration (configs/of3kit_stock_runner.yml).
The kit's `pred --mode off` runs the same thing in a clean subprocess, which peak_mem.py cannot wrap;
calling upstream directly with that yaml is the same program with a readable memory counter. This is
the denominator for the exact/fast speed-ups: same code, same weights, same yaml base, same queries.
The OpenFold3 CODEBASE on the openbind weights, launched through Anthropic's `openfold3_ob0`
optimization kit (github.com/anthropics/uplifting-biomolecular-modeling, Apache-2.0, released
2026-09-17 as a reference release that is not maintained). The kit is NOT vendored: launcher.kit_dir
names a clone at launcher.kit_commit, and profiling/setup_kit_env.sh builds everything the launcher
block names. engine stays `of3`: same codebase family, same PyTorch memory counter, same of3_pool
queries as of3_openbind_templateoff; only the launcher differs.
launcher.kit_config: the kit's per-card file that is SOURCED for its environment bootstrap. The kit
ships h100|a100|h200|b200|b300 and nothing for this GPU (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, compute capability
12.0). The card files differ in exactly one functional line, MODEL_OPT_TARGET_GPU, which only the
`big` mode's two size gates consume; for off/exact/fast the kernel tables are resolved from the real
compute capability at run time (cc 12.0 has no tuned rows and gets the kit's safe settings, which
it reports on its own). h100 is the kit's tested reference and is used for that reason only.
launcher.cuda_home / ld_library_path: two host workarounds, explained in profiling/setup_kit_env.sh
(deviations 2 and 3). Override any launcher path without editing this file: AF3OF3_KIT_DIR,
AF3OF3_KIT_ENV, AF3OF3_KIT_CUDA_HOME, AF3OF3_KIT_LD; the checkpoint via AF3OF3_OF3_CKPT as for of3.
warmup_runs 1: each size is run once untimed before the recorded run. The kit compiles Triton
kernels per tensor shape inside the timed loop (its README: compare modes on a second run), and
stock's Triton kernels autotune per shape too, so all three kit arms warm equally. Default 0 leaves
every other arm as it was.
use_templates=false for the same reason as the of3 arm: the converted queries carry none.
Recycles: OpenFold3's fixed 3, as for of3. Samples and seed as the other arms.
